title: Three-Emoji Character
prompt: Design a character inspired by these three things: a strawberry, an umbrella, and the moon.

title: Tiny Dream Room
prompt: Draw a tiny room that represents your dream creative workspace. Add at least five meaningful objects.

title: The Unexpected Letter
prompt: Write a short story that begins with: I wasn't supposed to open that letter.

title: 100-Word Universe
prompt: Create a complete fictional world in exactly 100 words.

title: 15-Second Story
prompt: Make a 15-second video that tells a beginning, middle, and ending without using dialogue.

title: Ordinary, Extraordinary
prompt: Photograph one ordinary object from three unusual angles and make it look cinematic.

title: Tiny Useful Tool
prompt: Build a tiny browser tool that solves one annoying everyday problem.

title: Sound of a Place
prompt: Create a short soundscape inspired by a place you love. Use at least three layers.

title: Upcycle Challenge
prompt: Turn one piece of packaging or waste into something decorative or useful.

title: Make It Weird
prompt: Choose any medium and create something based on a penguin running a luxury hotel on Mars.

title: Generative Poster
prompt: Create a poster where the layout changes randomly every time the page loads.

title: Message From Future You
prompt: Write a message from yourself ten years in the future. What did you become proud of?

title: Dream Creature
prompt: Invent a creature that only appears when someone falls asleep. Give it three magical abilities.

title: Color Hunt
prompt: Choose one color and photograph five completely different things that contain it.

title: Tiny Interactive Story
prompt: Create a mini interactive story where the reader makes at least three choices.

title: Mystery Box
prompt: Design packaging for a fictional product that doesn't exist yet.
